**SERVICE CONTRACT**

**THIS SERVICE CONTRACT** is made and entered into at Mumbai on this 1st day of February, 2024, by and between:

**SUNRISE COOPERATIVE HOUSING SOCIETY LIMITED**, a Cooperative Housing Society registered under the Maharashtra Co-operative Societies Act, 1960, having its registered office at Sunrise CHS Ltd., Plot No. 17, Sector 12, Kharghar, Navi Mumbai – 410210, represented herein by its Honorary Secretary, Mr. Ramesh Kulkarni, duly authorized by Resolution No. 14/2023-24 passed at the Managing Committee Meeting held on 15th January 2024 (hereinafter referred to as the "Society", which expression shall, unless repugnant to the context or meaning thereof, be deemed to mean and include its successors-in-title and assigns) of the FIRST PART;

**AND**

**GREENLEAF CLEANING SERVICES**, a proprietorship firm having its office at Shop No. 4, Ground Floor, Sai Krupa Building, Plot No. 28, Sector 15, CBD Belapur, Navi Mumbai – 400614, represented by its Proprietor, Mr. Suresh Patil (hereinafter referred to as the "Contractor", which expression shall, unless repugnant to the context or meaning thereof, be deemed to mean and include its heirs, successors, and permitted assigns) of the SECOND PART.

The Society and the Contractor are hereinafter collectively referred to as the "Parties" and individually as a "Party".

**WHEREAS:**

A. The Society is the owner and occupier of the residential complex known as "Sunrise CHS Ltd." situated at Plot No. 17, Sector 12, Kharghar, Navi Mumbai – 410210, comprising of 4 residential towers (A, B, C, and D), a clubhouse, a swimming pool, and common areas.

B. The Society requires regular cleaning and housekeeping services for its premises, common areas, and amenities.

C. The Contractor has represented that it possesses the requisite experience, expertise, personnel, and resources to provide the said services.

D. The Managing Committee of the Society, by Resolution No. 14/2023-24 dated 15th January 2024, approved the engagement of the Contractor for the provision of cleaning and housekeeping services upon the terms and conditions contained herein.

E. The Parties have agreed to enter into this Contract for the provision of the aforesaid services.

**NOW, THEREFORE, IN CONSIDERATION OF THE MUTUAL COVENANTS AND AGREEMENTS HEREIN CONTAINED, THE PARTIES AGREE AS FOLLOWS:**

**1. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATION**

1.1. In this Contract, unless the context otherwise requires:
(a) "Premises" means the entire property of the Society, including all buildings, towers, basements, podiums, clubhouse, swimming pool, common areas, lobbies, staircases, elevators, corridors, terraces, and such other areas as may be specified by the Society from time to time.
(b) "Services" means the cleaning and housekeeping services as more particularly described in Clause 2 and Annexure A hereto.
(c) "Working Day" means all days of the week except Sundays and public holidays declared by the Society.
(d) "Contract Period" means the period commencing from 1st February 2024 and ending on 31st January 2025, unless terminated earlier in accordance with the provisions of this Contract.

1.2. The headings in this Contract are for convenience only and shall not affect the interpretation hereof.

**2. SCOPE OF SERVICES**

2.2. The Contractor shall deploy a minimum of the following personnel on the Premises:

| Sr. No. | Category of Personnel | Minimum Number | Working Hours |
|---------|----------------------|----------------|---------------|
| 1 | Supervisor | 1 | 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM, all days |
| 2 | General Cleaners | 8 | 7:00 AM to 3:00 PM (4 cleaners) and 2:00 PM to 10:00 PM (4 cleaners) |
| 3 | Garbage Collection Staff | 2 | 6:00 AM to 10:00 AM and 4:00 PM to 8:00 PM |
| 4 | Clubhouse Attendant | 1 | 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM, all days |
